text: Move from the center of pleasure. When you walk, allow your movements to become more plastic and as if coming from the pelvis. This is not about vulgar swaying of the hips, but about your attention in the pelvic area—on the sensation of pleasure that is always present there, and the dynamics of movement precisely from the pelvic area—not from the abdomen, chest, arms or legs—but precisely from the pelvis—as if pouring over and amplifying the basic sensation of pleasure. Having mastered such a gait, learn to perform all movements in the same way—the movement of a hand, the raising of the eyes, the turn of the head...
